scope: Corollary 2.2 of the manuscript “A local Penrose inequality for conformal perturbations of Schwarzschild–anti-de Sitter data” (preprints/A-local-Penrose-inequality-for-conformal-perturbations-of-Schwarzschild-anti-de-Sitter-data-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 260 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 624b287b6675a962), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 6. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: In addition to the hypotheses of Theorem 2.1, suppose qss ≥ 0 on S. Assume, for every sufficiently small positive ϵ, that no compact smooth embedded two- sided surface in the interior enclosing S has θ+ ≤ 0 everywhere, and that every smooth enclosing surface has area at least Aϵ. Disconnected enclosing competitors are allowed, and S itself is allowed in the area infimum. Then the exact local Penrose inequality holds with Amin(S) = Aϵ.
